description: The faucet answers HTTP 503 with a body that is not JSON, on /health and /chain. Gateway and RPC answer. Every value is made up for this test, shaped after the devnet as read on 2026-11-11. The two reads of the upgrade watch at the finalized head, right after its runtime version, are synthetic too: state_getStorage of System.LastRuntimeUpgrade answers the record research/2026-11-12-runtime-upgrade/results.json gives at boundary.0.last_runtime_upgrade.hex (tzkv-runtime 1014014), and of System.AuthorizedUpgrade answers null, as authorization.authorized_upgrade_at.0.value gives; upgrade_answers names both.
